# Seven-repository acceptance controller

Use the complete [seven-repository repair and acceptance prompt](../../docs/SEVEN_REPOSITORY_ACCEPTANCE_PROMPT.md). Each child agent owns exactly one repository. With three child slots, rotate the seven repository tasks; never assign a dual-repository edit task.

The exact inventory is AspenOps-Agent, TsaoSciComputation, TSAO-PROCESSING-SKILL, ResinDB-Pro-by-SunHJ, TsaoDFT_skill, TsaoSciResearcher, and OpenDeepMind_skill. Freeze six full main SHAs and SELF for this controller in repositories.json only after the corresponding source is published and verified. Existing pins must be checked against sole remote main before execution.

Baseline gates precede phase one; every phase-one job must finish before phase two. Each of seven repositories needs two separate v2 segments with at least 10,800 seconds of successful test-process wall time per segment. Fourteen independent receipts, raw logs, raw JUnit, pytest public-hook event sidecars, argv/source/interpreter/environment identities, UTC and monotonic clocks, full command-cycle coverage, and a predecessor hash are rechecked independently. A command exceeding 1,801 seconds, a changed remote main, a failing event or report, incomplete evidence, v1 evidence, or SMOKE_ONLY cannot qualify.

Pytest successful subtests may contribute to the JUnit summary without separate testcase leaves. The observer preserves all outcomes and the unmodified XML; it never changes collection or results. Vitest uses strict summary-to-leaf reconciliation. A synthetic verifier fixture or one-second subprocess smoke validates the controller only and contributes no six-hour evidence.

This is segmented Linux software regression, not CPU time, uninterrupted service uptime, actual commercial-solver execution, or scientific acceptance. Do not claim completion until the final verifier validates all fourteen actual receipts for this run and attempt.
